component.name: MainScene
component.script:
' ── config ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ' Change BASE_URL to your machine's LAN IP when running on a real Roku device. ' (Roku cannot reach 127.0.0.1 on your PC — use e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8080) CONST BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
CONST TABS = ["Pipelines", "Cloud", "Notifs", "Echo AI", "Diagnostics"] CONST REFRESH_SECS = 30 ' auto-refresh interval
' colours CONST C_BG = "0x0D1117FF" ' deep github dark CONST C_HEADER = "0x161B22FF" CONST C_TAB_IDLE = "0x21262DFF" CONST C_TAB_SEL = "0x238636FF" ' github green CONST C_TEXT = "0xE6EDF3FF" CONST C_SUBTEXT = "0x8B949EFF" CONST C_BORDER = "0x30363DFF"
' ── init ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── sub init() m.activeTab = 0 buildUI() setupTimer() showPanel(0) focusTabStrip() end sub
' ── UI construction ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── sub buildUI() ' full-screen background bg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bg.width = 1280 bg.height = 720 bg.color = C_BG
buildHeader() buildTabStrip() buildPanels() buildFooter() end sub
sub buildHeader() bar = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bar.translation = [0, 0] bar.width = 1280 bar.height = 68 bar.color = C_HEADER
title = m.top.createChild("Label") title.translation = [40, 14] title.text = "⬛ MasterChief DevOps" title.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" title.color = C_TEXT
sep = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") sep.translation = [0, 68] sep.width = 1280 sep.height = 2 sep.color = C_BORDER
m.clockLabel = m.top.createChild("Label") m.clockLabel.translation = [1050, 22] m.clockLabel.text = "" m.clockLabel.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.clockLabel.color = C_SUBTEXT
updateClock() end sub
sub buildTabStrip() m.tabRects = [] m.tabLabels = [] tabY = 70 tabH = 52 tabW = 1280 / TABS.count()
for i = 0 to TABS.count() - 1 r = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") r.translation = [i * tabW, tabY] r.width = tabW - 2 r.height = tabH r.color = C_TAB_IDLE m.tabRects.push(r)
lbl = m.top.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [i * tabW + 20, tabY + 13] lbl.text = TABS[i] lbl.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" lbl.color = C_SUBTEXT m.tabLabels.push(lbl) end for
' separator below tab strip sep2 = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") sep2.translation = [0, tabY + tabH] sep2.width = 1280 sep2.height = 2 sep2.color = C_BORDER end sub
sub buildPanels() ' Lazy-create panel components; all start hidden m.panels = [ createPanel("PipelinesPanel"), createPanel("CloudPanel"), createPanel("NotifsPanel"), createPanel("EchoPanel"), createPanel("DiagPanel") ] end sub
function createPanel(compName as String) as Object p = m.top.createChild(compName) p.translation = [0, 124] p.visible = false return p end function
sub buildFooter() bar = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bar.translation = [0, 694] bar.width = 1280 bar.height = 26 bar.color = C_HEADER
hint = m.top.createChild("Label") hint.translation = [40, 698] hint.text = "◀ ▶ Switch tab ▲▼ Scroll panel * Refresh now Back / Home to exit" hint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" hint.color = C_SUBTEXT end sub
' ── tab switching ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── sub showPanel(idx as Integer) CONST C_TAB_IDLE_L = "0x21262DFF" CONST C_TAB_SEL_L = "0x238636FF"
for i = 0 to m.panels.count() - 1 m.panels[i].visible = (i = idx) m.tabRects[i].color = iif(i = idx, C_TAB_SEL_L, C_TAB_IDLE_L) m.tabLabels[i].color = iif(i = idx, "0xFFFFFFFF", "0x8B949EFF") end for
m.activeTab = idx ' trigger data load on the newly-visible panel m.panels[idx].callFunc("load", {}) end sub
' ── timer (clock + auto-refresh) ────────────────────────────────────────── sub setupTimer() m.timer = m.top.createChild("Timer") m.timer.duration = 1 m.timer.repeat = true m.timer.observeField("fire", "onTick") m.timer.control = "start" m.tickCount = 0 end sub
sub onTick() m.tickCount = m.tickCount + 1 updateClock() if m.tickCount mod REFRESH_SECS = 0 m.panels[m.activeTab].callFunc("load", {}) end if end sub
sub updateClock() dt = CreateObject("roDateTime") dt.ToLocalTime() h = dt.GetHours() min = dt.GetMinutes() sec = dt.GetSeconds() m.clockLabel.text = RightPad(h) + ":" + RightPad(min) + ":" + RightPad(sec) end sub
function RightPad(n as Integer) as String s = str(n).trim() if len(s) = 1 then s = "0" + s return s end function
' ── key handling ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── sub focusTabStrip() m.top.setFocus(true) end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false if key = "left" if m.activeTab > 0 showPanel(m.activeTab - 1) end if return true else if key = "right" if m.activeTab < TABS.count() - 1 showPanel(m.activeTab + 1) end if return true else if key = "replay" ' * button = refresh now m.panels[m.activeTab].callFunc("load", {}) return true end if return false end function
